gloss: with a cool draft; with a cold airy feeling

definitions.gloss: with a cool, airy, or drafty sensation; with a tingling cool feeling
definitions.explanation: Mimetic word (擬態語) describing the sensation of cool air flowing over or through something — like wind through a gap, mint on the tongue, or cold air on the skin. Can feel refreshing or unpleasantly chilly depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すき{間|ま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧すーすー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{冷気|れいき}→冷気：21352_reiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧。
examples.english: Cold air flows in through the gaps in the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦ミント→ミント：09650_minto⟧⟦キャンディー→キャンディー：23081_kyandii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すーすー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When you eat a mint candy, your mouth gets a cool tingly feeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すーすー⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひきそうだ。
examples.english: Going outside on a cold day in this thin shirt, the cold air passes right through and I feel like I'll catch a cold.

notes:
Mimetic word (擬態語) evoking a smooth, flowing cool sensation. Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a predicate: すーすー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すーすー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel a cool draft; to have a cool tingly sensation
- すーすー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: cool air blows through
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すーすー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel a cool sensation in the mouth (e.g. from mint)
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すーすー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel cold air on the body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ひやっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: suddenly cold — emphasizes the surprise or shock of an abrupt cold sensation
- ⟦ひんやり→ひんやり：05836_hinyari⟧: coolly, refreshingly — a gentle, pleasant coolness
- ⟦さらさら→さらさら：05255_sarasara⟧: smoothly, with light airiness — more about texture and flow
